verified_facts.text: Amós Restaurant is led by Executive Chef Jesús Sánchez and draws on the cuisine of Cantabria and Northern Spain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Jesús Sánchez weaves the soul of Northern Spain into every plate

verified_facts.text: Amós serves local delicacies such as Cantabrian anchovies, Riofrío caviar and organic wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor local delicacies—Cantabrian anchovies, Riofrío caviar, and organic wines.

verified_facts.text: Las Brasas de Castellana serves traditional Spanish cuisine around a grill, with an open kitchen and a garden terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather around the lively grill in Las Brasas de la Castellana, with an open kitchen, sweeping windows and a vibrant garden terrace

verified_facts.text: Breakfast at Las Brasas de Castellana ranges from a continental spread to à la carte dishes prepared on the grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: set the tone for breakfast, from a continental spread to à la carte dishes prepared on the grill

verified_facts.text: Tarde.O Bar combines a bar with a modern terrace and serves handcrafted cocktails and gourmet bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tarde.O Bar is a vibrant social hub blending a timeless bar with a modern terrace. Savor handcrafted cocktails and gourmet bites

verified_facts.text: Flor y Nata Patisserie is an all-day cafe for morning coffees, light lunches and afternoon get-togethers.
verified_facts.excerpt: An all-day cafe that elevates morning coffees, light lunches and afternoon get-togethers

verified_facts.text: Sunday Brunch is held at Las Brasas de Castellana with a live band.
verified_facts.excerpt: Make Sundays extra special with Brunch at Las Brasas de Castellana. A day to enjoy with the family, including a live band.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the Executive Chef on a guided tour of local markets.
verified_facts.excerpt: A guided tour through the local markets and hidden gems of the city to find local specialties to savor.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a private tour and picnic at El Escorial.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape the city for a private tour and a refined picnic at El Escorial

verified_facts.text: The Signature Suites are Houses located on the hotel's rooftop with views of Madrid.
verified_facts.excerpt: One-of-a-kind Houses are located on the rooftop of the hotel, with mesmerizing views of Madrid.

verified_facts.text: Combinable suites and houses offer two to four bedrooms and a separate living area.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering the possibility of choosing from two to four bedrooms and a separate living area

verified_facts.text: Rooms have garden or boulevard views.
verified_facts.excerpt: City retreats with garden or boulevard views, crafted interiors and a quiet sense of Spanish elegance

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Madrid's Paseo de la Castellana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on Madrid’s famous Paseo de la Castellana, this hotel has immediate cachet

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within strolling distance of major art museums and within a block of a Metro station.
verified_facts.excerpt: You'll be within strolling distance of major art museums, deluxe shopping, and within a block of a Metro station, too.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Palace and Gran Vía are a long walk from the hotel, but taxis are plentiful.
verified_facts.excerpt: and Gran Vía are quite a hike, but taxis are plentiful and rarely expensive
